name: Exp_AnchoredMomentumCandle
summary: This EA trades based on the AnchoredMomentumCandle custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (colored candle value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (value 0). It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, with separate controls for enabling/disabling buy and sell entry and exit logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于AnchoredMomentumCandle自定义指标进行交易，当指标发出看涨动量信号（蜡烛值为2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（值为0）时开空仓。它使用可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈水平，并支持分别控制买卖方向的入场和出场逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于AnchoredMomentumCandle指标的动量跟踪策略。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4在信号Bar上检测到值为2时开多仓，值为0时开空仓，同时前一根蜡烛的颜色状态（Col[0]）需满足变化条件（Col[0]<2开多，Col[0]>0开空），这确保了动量方向的转换而非延续。出场条件依赖独立的布尔开关控制：BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数分别控制是否在反向信号出现时平仓，配合固定止损1000点和止盈2000点出场。仓位管理采用MM参数控制仓位大小，支持LOT和MARGIN两种模式，通过MMMode参数切换。资金管理方面，MM默认0.1表示10%的资金分配比例，采用TradeAlgorithms库中的标准化函数进行下单。策略仅在新Bar形成时或需要重新计算时才执行信号判断，避免了逐Tick重复开仓的问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core of this EA is a momentum-following approach based on the AnchoredMomentumCandle custom indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 4 detects a value of 2 (bullish candle) at the signal bar, and a sell position opens when the value is 0 (bearish candle), with an additional check on the previous candle's color state (Col[0]<2 for buys, Col[0]>0 for sells) to confirm a momentum transition rather than continuation. Exit conditions rely on independent boolean switches: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose control whether positions are closed on opposite signals, combined with a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing uses the MM parameter defaulting to 0.1 (10% allocation), supporting both LOT and MARGIN modes via the MMMode parameter. Money management delegates to standardized functions in the TradeAlgorithms library for order placement. The strategy only evaluates signals on new bar formation or when recalculation is needed, preventing repeated tick-level entries.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金分配比例，控制仓位大小

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位模式：LOT固定手数或MARGIN按保证金计算
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net free margin/net balance/fixed lot)

parameters.name: MomPeriod
parameters.description: 锚定动量计算中SMA的周期
parameters.description_en: SMA period in anchored momentum calculation

parameters.name: SmoothPeriod
parameters.description: 锚定动量计算中EMA平滑周期
parameters.description_en: EMA smoothing period in anchored momentum calculation

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于动量转换信号交易，避免追涨杀跌
买卖方向的入场和出场可独立控制，灵活性高
采用新Bar检测机制，避免逐Tick重复计算和重复开仓
包含止损和止盈设置，有基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on momentum transition signals, avoiding chasing trends
Independent control for buy/sell entry and exit directions, offering high flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents per-tick recalculation and duplicate entries
Includes stop loss and take profit settings, providing a basic risk control framework
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
依赖自定义指标AnchoredMomentumCandle，指标缺失时EA无法运行且错误信息为乱码
未显式检查持仓状态，可能依赖TradeAlgorithms库的内部逻辑来避免重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed SL/TP values (1000/2000 points) do not adapt to market volatility (ATR)
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread conditions
Depends on the custom AnchoredMomentumCandle indicator; if missing, the EA fails with garbled error messages
No explicit position check in OnTick; relies on TradeAlgorithms library internals to avoid duplicate entries
improvements: 将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，以适应不同市场波动环境
添加点差过滤机制，在点差过大时暂停开仓
增加显式的持仓检查逻辑，不依赖外部库的隐式行为
improvements_en: Replace fixed SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to varying market volatility
Add a spread filter to suspend entries when spreads are excessively wide
Add explicit position checking logic instead of relying on the library's implicit behavior

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在低波动市场可能止损过宽而在高波动市场止盈不足
缺少显式持仓检查，依赖外部库的内部逻辑可能存在边界情况风险
依赖自定义指标可用性，指标缺失时仅返回INIT_FAILED但无有效错误提示
risk_points_en: Fixed SL/TP ignores market volatility; too wide in low-vol and insufficient TP in high-vol environments
No explicit position check; relying on external library internals may have edge-case risks
Depends on custom indicator availability; failure only returns INIT_FAILED with no readable error message

It uses configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit levels, with separate controls for enabling/disabling buy and sell entry and exit logic.
